newsitem.title: GERMANY: DHL sees 10-12mln mark 1996 Germany profit.
newsitem.headline: DHL sees 10-12mln mark 1996 Germany profit.

text.p: DHL Worldwide Express said its German division was set to show a 1996 net profit of 10-12 million marks.
Sales revenues in Germany rose 11 percent to 354 million marks last year and 9.4 million shipments were carried, a statement said.
In 1995, DHL Germany made a net profit of 10 million marks on a turnover of 320 million and transported 8.3 million shipments.
DHL said it would continue to expand its 48-strong network of express centres outside main population areas with 17 new outlets planned this year and in 1998.
Investment would also be increased in corporate electronic data interchange (EDI) and tracking-and-tracing systems, it added.
Its 'Import Express' service launched last year, allowing German clients to order goods and DHL services at the same, time had shown the expected growth rates, DHL said.
Staff numbers in Germany rose to 2,009 at the end of 1996 from 1,900 in 1995, it added.
